title: Six friends at a round table
intro: Six friends, Asha, Bilal, Chitra, Dev, Esha and Farhan, sit at a round table with six equally spaced seats, all facing the centre.
clues: Asha sits second to the right of Bilal.
Dev does not sit next to Bilal.
Esha sits immediately to the left of Chitra.

why: Fix Asha's seat. Clue 1 puts Bilal two seats to Asha's left, and clue 2 puts Chitra opposite Asha.
Clue 4 puts Esha on Chitra's left. Dev and Farhan take the last two seats; one of them is next to Bilal, and clue 3 keeps Dev out of it. So Dev sits on Asha's right, opposite Bilal.

questions.stem: Who sits immediately to the right of Esha?
why: Clue 4 says Esha is immediately to the left of Chitra, so Chitra is immediately to the right of Esha. No other clue is needed.

questions.stem: How many people sit between Farhan and Esha, counting the shorter way round?
why: Clockwise from Asha the seats are Asha, Farhan, Bilal, Chitra, Esha, Dev.
Farhan and Esha are opposite each other, so two people sit between them either way.

questions.stem: If clue 3 is dropped, how many seatings fit the remaining clues? (Seatings that differ only by turning the table count once.)
why: Clues 1, 2 and 4 fix Asha, Bilal, Chitra and Esha.
Dev and Farhan can take the two free seats either way round, so two seatings fit.

steps: Facing the centre, a person's right is the next seat anticlockwise (seen from above).
Fix Asha. Clue 1: Bilal is two seats to Asha's left. Clue 2: Chitra opposite Asha. Clue 4: Esha on Chitra's left.
Two seats remain, beside Asha. Clue 3 keeps Dev away from Bilal, so Farhan sits between Asha and Bilal.
